'''Michael Schiemer ROLLIN''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Michael Schiemer]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-17995">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/17995 ROLLIN], DeckTech (Michael "The Rattler" Schiemer, 1 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/17995/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/17995/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Michael Schiemer]]
* '''Published:''' 1 August 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''ROLLIN''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTat SYCFA Schiemer DS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits grabber: not in GEMP)
* '''Strategy:''' A good tie deck with plenty of tallon rolls.

The post names no Defensive Shields.

The post also lists 2x grabber, which matches no known card; it is shown as posted and counted in the published total.

== Original post ==

'''ROLLIN'''
* '''Author:''' Michael "The Rattler" Schiemer
* '''Published:''' August 1, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' A good tie deck with plenty of tallon rolls.

=== Strategy ===

Clarification the tallon rolls are combo cards, not the premeire ones

Also in response to reviews, this is a tie deck. It does not need many or any characters to fight withAlso, the strategy is very basic in a tie deck and i would think most people would know it by now.

Its a tie deck, nuff said.
